verdict.rationale: Apify's platform is API-first: full OpenAPI spec, official JS/Python API clients, CLI, webhooks, and Actor management (run, schedule, publish, share, permissions) are all documented as programmatically accessible, mirroring UI capabilities like scheduling, monitoring, publishing to Store, and org management. Missing for 10: no explicit statement or audit confirming 100% UI-feature parity with the API, so some edge/admin UI features may lack independent confirmation.
